name: Moa
source:
"We don't have enough people for this time's match. So can I ask you?"

Position: Cosplay, Programming

A famous cross-dressing cosplayer and an engineer working for a game company. The only female inhabitant in the share house. She usually has a plain appearance and insisting that it's a temporary figure that helps the world keeps going. Has a bright, fluffy personality, but her room is dirty.
